text: Discounts come straight out of margin, and they show up in the reports. A reason makes each one explainable later. Tom's bill needs a goodwill discount.
Only managers lower a price, and always with a reason.
Click the pencil next to the price.
Type the new price, 60, and press Enter.
The line now shows the new price, with the regular price struck through.
It records the old price, the new price, and who changed it.
If a family qualifies for an employer promotion, it waits at checkout on their first visit.
Click Confirm promotion to apply it, once per client.
The twenty dollars comes off the total.
The most common mistakes are discounting without a clear reason, and discounting a member line the plan already covers. Remember: only managers can lower a price, and every discount needs a reason.
